items.name: Candidate
items.summary: A candidate is the result of running a prefilter on a haystack at a particular position.

methods.name: into_option
methods.summary: Convert this candidate into an option. This is useful when callers do not distinguish between true positives and false positives (i.e., the caller must always confirm the match).

items.name: Prefilter
items.summary: A prefilter for accelerating a search.

methods.name: find_in
methods.signature: fn find_in(&self, haystack: &[u8], span: Span) -> Candidate
methods.summary: Execute a search in the haystack within the span given. If a match or a possible match is returned, then it is guaranteed to occur within the bounds of the span.
